checks.overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth + 1, reported per element that escapes the viewport's right edge with no clipping ancestor. severity: high
checks.offscreen: element rendered past the viewport's right edge but cut off by an ancestor's overflow. severity: medium
checks.clipped-text: scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1 with overflow hidden and no text-overflow: ellipsis, or scrollHeight > clientHeight + 1 on a single-line control. severity: medium
checks.target-size: button / [role=button] / [role=tab] / [role=switch] / a / input / select rendered under 24x24 CSS px. severity: medium
checks.accessible-name: interactive element with no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, wrapping label or descendant alt. high when nothing at all names it, medium when only a placeholder or value does
checks.tab-semantics: [role=tab] needs aria-selected and a resolvable aria-controls; [role=tablist] needs an accessible name and exactly one tab at tabIndex 0. severity: high
checks.contrast: computed colour composited over the nearest opaque background ancestor, WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratio, flagged under 4.5:1 (3:1 at >= 18.66px, or >= 14px bold). severity: medium
checks.focus-visible: each interactive element focused in turn; flagged when outline-style is none or zero-width, box-shadow is none, and no border, background or colour changed. severity: medium
